results: Requirement N35 verified: Integrity and authenticity verified against independently trusted release identity/key (ed25519-primary-2026 / 79b5562e8fe654f94078b112e8a98ba7901f853ae695bed7e0e3910bad049664).

Release verification CLI and library delivered in scripts/verify-release.mjs: verifies existence, non-zero sizes, byte-exact SHA-256 digests, and Ed25519 signatures, failing closed on any modified byte (CHECKSUM_MISMATCH), unknown signer (UNTRUSTED_OR_MISSING_SIGNER), or corrupt signature (INVALID_SIGNATURE).

Engine durability verified: internal/storage/Adapter enforces atomic writes, operation conflict rejection on replayed operation IDs, and private resource fail-closed access control.
